model_choice.picked: veo3.1_fast, ratio 1920:1080, duration 8, audio false = 80 credits per clip (10 per second)
model_choice.why: The only 1080p image-to-video at a sane price, so the 9:16 crop (608 px of source width) stays sharp. Tested twice on this cast: faces hold, real micro-acting, clean hands. gen4_turbo (5/s) and gen4.5 (12/s) are 720p only; a 9:16 crop of 720p is 405 px wide and goes mushy on phones.
prompt_lessons: Never write 'he listens' near a phone: Veo made him take a phone call (T1). Say the phone stays low and never rises.
Timestamp the actions ('at five seconds...'): Veo follows them (T2's head turn landed at 2.7s for 'after two seconds').
A static hood camera plus 'the truck does not move' keeps backgrounds and plates stable.
Always pass the negativePrompt; always audio:false (with audio it costs 15/s and invents voices).
api_notes: POST https://api.dev.runwayml.com/v1/image_to_video with headers Authorization: Bearer $RUNWAY_KEY and X-Runway-Version: 2024-11-06; poll GET /v1/tasks/{id}.
promptImage: base64 data URI of the PNG keyframe (all are under 5 MB).
Download outputs with curl --retry 5 --retry-all-errors. Python urllib hit connection resets from the CDN 3 times; the output URL can be re-fetched from GET /v1/tasks/{id}.

shots.purpose: HOOK. First frame of the film: the giant deadpan driver and his gleeful passenger holding his phone. Her tap installs Elmo.
shots.promptText: Static camera mounted on the hood of a parked vintage pickup truck, looking through the windshield at the two people inside; the engine idles with a faint vibration. On the left, the woman in the mustard corduroy jacket holds a smartphone up with its back to camera, grinning wickedly at the driver; at half a second she taps the screen once with her thumb, then turns to watch his face, delighted, shoulders bouncing with silent giggles. On the right, the huge bearded driver stares straight ahead, completely deadpan, both hands on the wheel, and slowly blinks once. At five seconds he sighs through his nose and turns the steering wheel to the left, hand over hand; the truck pulls away from the curb. Nobody speaks. Photoreal, 35mm film look, Kodak Portra colors, gentle grain, naturalistic acting.

shots.promptText: Static camera mounted on the hood, looking through the windshield at a big bearded man in a red flannel shirt and navy cap, alone in the cab of a parked vintage pickup truck. rules: Generate must-haves in order of risk: S06, S13, S01, S04, S05, S10, S02, S08, S03. Review each against the QA list before generating the next.
A retake is allowed only for a QA failure (hands, faces, identity drift, wrong action, text artifacts); max 2 takes per shot, then use its fallback.
Nice-to-haves only once every must-have has passed QA and at least 120 credits of reserve are untouched.
Veo 3.1 Fast at 1920:1080 ONLY accepts duration 8 (the API rejects 4 and 6 at 1080p). 720p allows 4/6/8 but is too soft for the 9:16 crop.
Check the balance before and after every call and append every call to film/runway2/ledger.json (task id, model, seconds, credits, purpose). Never write the key anywhere.
